genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. remains the USDGO issuerEntity, consistent with USAT, USDtb and USDPT sidecars. Its covered-stablecoin terms identify the bank as sole issuer/obligor, describe payment/settlement use and provide dollar par-value redemption to onboarded Clients; Non-Clients lack a contractual redemption right until becoming Clients. The bank's May 1, 2026 disclosure expressly expects to become a PPSI once GENIUS is effective, supporting issuer-announced-intent and the federal-qualified-nonbank pathway. The ordinary OCC national trust charter does not establish GENIUS approval. No public named PPSI approval or official pending application was located; no assertion is made about nonpublic submissions. The August 31 reserve examination, signed September 28, supports monthlyAttestationPresent but expressly provides no opinion on legal compliance. Federal issuer frameworks remain proposed; Treasury expects January 18, 2027 effectiveness and July 18, 2028 for the general DASP offer-sale prohibition.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification or named official pending application was located for Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. as USDGO issuer in the checked regulator materials and targeted searches. The reviewed federal documents describe proposed issuer frameworks; Treasury's September 30 interim final rule concerns state certification procedures and states that certifications await PRA approval. Ordinary licenses and reserve disclosures do not establish PPSI approval. No token-specific GENIUS warning or prohibition was located. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof about nonpublic filings.
